title: China's iQiyi plans to overhaul its streaming service into an AI content hub, with an app redesign and Nadou Pro AI tool handling "every aspect of film-making" (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: China's iQiyi plans to overhaul its streaming service into an AI content hub, with an app redesign and Nadou Pro AI tool handling “every aspect of film-making” — IQiyi Inc. expects AI to create the bulk of its films and shows in five years, a monumental industry shift that spurred …
